source.description:
Bootstrap service-knowledge (v0.7.0+) into this repo.

## Scope

- Run `service-knowledge install` (auto-vendors machinery + wires PreToolUse activator + SessionStart cataloger + PostToolUse drift-detector hooks + builds FTS5 index).
- Populate `.xtrm/skills/<pack>/service-knowledge/service-registry.json` with the services hosted here.
- Author per-service SKILL.md via `/creating-service-knowledge` (Phase 1 scaffolder → Phase 2 deep dive → Phase 3 finalize: index build + verifier smoke + hook confirm + communicate).

## Definition of done

- [ ] `service-knowledge status` reports installed == package version
- [ ] `service-knowledge index stats` shows every service registered + item count > 0
- [ ] Each per-service SKILL.md passes verifier gate (`service-knowledge help verifier`)
- [ ] Umbrella `.xtrm/skills/<pack>/service-knowledge/SKILL.md` regenerated from the registry

## References

- Package: ~/dev/xtrm/packages/service-knowledge/ (v0.7.0)
- Installer: ~/dev/xtrm/packages/service-knowledge/install.sh (auto-clones vaultctl)
- Umbrella Jira epic: ISSUE-51 (mercuryintel.atlassian.net/browse/ISSUE-51)
- CLI help: `service-knowledge help topics`
